title: Houlihan Lokey Bolsters Equity Capital Solutions Capabilities With Senior Hire
summary: Dan Buffery Joins as a Managing Director Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Dan Buffery has joined the firm’s Capital Solutions Group as a Managing Director. Mr. Buffery is based in New York and will help lead the firm’s North American GP-led secondaries advisory practice within Equity Capital Solutions. Mr. Buffery joins the firm following nearly 10 years at HarbourVest Partners, where he most recently served as a Managing Director in its Infrastructure and Real Assets Group. While there, he was a senior investment professional and was responsible for leading GP- and LP-led secondaries investments. He was a voting member of the Real Assets Investment Committee and served as the Portfolio Manager for the HarbourVest Infrastructure Income Partnership.
